basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm Alex, a 34-year-old nutrition enthusiast living in Portland, Oregon. I work as a freelance content creator, specializing in health and wellness topics. I enjoy diving deep into the science behind nutrition and sharing my findings with others. In my free time, you'll find me hiking in the beautiful Oregon trails or experimenting with new recipes in the kitchen. I'm married to my college sweetheart, and we have a lovable golden retriever named Max. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work or during lunch breaks.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Nutrition Science, and I've spent the last decade working in various health-related roles, including as a dietary consultant. My interest in supplements began as a personal endeavor to improve my own well-being, which later grew into a professional focus. I keep up with the latest research through scientific journals and online courses.
